title: Sorbitol-modified graphene oxide-iron oxide nanocomposite for efficient doxycycline removal: mechanistic and kinetic insights
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4214-4227
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07287E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Afia Murshida Kusum, Md Humayun Kabir, Md. Safiqul Islam, Md Sakil, Sabina Yasmin
This study reports the synthesis of a novel, eco-friendly and highly effective sorbitol-functionalized graphene oxide-iron oxide (GO/Fe-SBT) nanocomposite for the enhanced removal of doxycycline (DOX) from aqueous solutions.
